article_framing_rejections.headline: Infant death investigation reveals messages warning father baby was starving

lead_independence.headline: Infant death investigation reveals messages warning father baby was starving
lead_independence.lead: Text messages obtained during the investigation into the death of a 3-month-old infant in Fort Pierce showed family members repeatedly warning both parents that something was wrong. On August 12, 2025, messages sent to Nicole Maxwell stated, 'The baby's got nothing to eat. I don't know what to give him.' Days later, additional messages warned that the baby was sick, covered in marks and sleeping constantly. Other messages urged Jason Gunter to come to Florida because something was wrong with the infant. According to detectives, neither parent took action that resulted in immediate medical care for the child.
